{{Quote|When I arrived to try out for this squadron, I thought I was the only one at the end of my rope as a pilot. But it looks more and more as though all of us are walking in thermal boots on thin ice.|Kell Tainer|<ref name="Wraith">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
'''Thermal boots''' were a type of [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Kell Tainer]] compared the state of his [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] to a group of people walking in thermal books on thin [[Water/Legends|ice]].<ref name="Wraith" />
